title: Lab - Admission controllers
description: Enable a built-in admission plugin and watch it act.
scenario: Enable a built-in admission plugin and watch it act. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Which are enabled
tasks.instructions: List the admission plugins the API server currently enables.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Enable NamespaceAutoProvision
tasks.instructions: Edit the static Pod manifest to enable NamespaceAutoProvision and create a Pod in a namespace that does not exist.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Disable DefaultStorageClass
tasks.instructions: Disable the DefaultStorageClass plugin and confirm a new PVC gets no class.
